hitset: 24-bit station/layer/side coverage; bit23-(station*6+layer*2+side); not cluster/strip identities
hitset_alignment: pushed before station1/2/3 and endpoint filters; no forced alignment
endpoint: first/last saved TrackParameters; endpoint transverse distance is not common-plane distance when z differs

extrapolation.start: upstream for VetoNu/Trig; downstream for Calo
extrapolation.covariance: unit diagonal in propagation setup; not measured per-track fit covariance
extrapolation.interpretation: coordinates at common reference plane, not detector channel/hit matching or significance

truth: MC-only matching PDG/barcode and parent PDG/barcode must match primary muon; truthHitRatio separately diagnosed
deployable: Track states/quality/geometry and raw scintillator/status are defined for data; data transfer performance not measured
